items.title: Create Codex Capability Harness reference documentation
items.acceptance_summary: All requested docs, ADRs, diagrams, contracts, examples, audits, and master spec exist and pass the frozen documentation quality bar.
items.next_action: Hand off the approved documentation set; begin implementation only at the Phase 1 gates.

items.title: Implement the contract-first Phase 1 Harness Kernel
items.acceptance_summary: Implement and verify the bounded kernel contracts, registry, classification, route model, authority, evidence, artifacts, state, stop engine, telemetry, local CLI, isolation layout and evidence package without runtime execution or global mutation.
items.next_action: Do not expand runtime scope until a separate Phase 2 specification, authority and execution gate is approved.

items.title: Implement the bounded Phase 2 Execution Kernel
items.acceptance_summary: Implement and verify local deterministic direct and graph execution with typed invocation, providers, authority, limits, artifacts, evidence, verification, assurance, repair, summary, telemetry, persistence and CLI while preserving all explicit non-goals.
items.next_action: Keep the bounded Phase 2 packet frozen; any payload or scope change requires a new evidence, manifest and independent-review cycle.

items.title: Implement the bounded read-only Codex host capability integration
items.origin: User-supplied Phase 3 Host Capability Integration specification
items.acceptance_summary: Inspect the real host without mutation, discover project/workspace/global capability roots, synthesize safe declarative manifests, load bounded metadata progressively, resolve trust/compatibility/duplicates/dependencies/conflicts, bridge selected metadata to the frozen registry/router, and prove honest telemetry with adversarial tests and evidence.
items.next_action: Keep the bounded Phase 3 payload frozen; any source, test, runtime configuration or scope change requires a new evidence, manifest and independent-review cycle.
